title: grapemots-protocol: frozen results and analysis tools for protocol-defined counting in aerial vineyard video
description:
Manifests, frozen results, analysis scripts and checksums supporting the paper Same Footage, Opposite Sign: Cadence, Coverage and Cancellation in UAV Video Counting (IEEE CBDCom 2026).

The archive carries the cadence intervention over 28 sequences, the annotation-thinning ladder, the frame-level alignment of a public release to its source video, the external contrast on MOT17 and MOT20, the adaptive-sampling arms, the low-score second-stage audit, the flight-clustered bootstrap, and the on-board and link cost benchmark. Every table value the paper reports is recomputed from these frozen outputs by cadence2026_0813/tools/smoke_test.py, which needs stock Python 3.9+ and no GPU, imagery or model weights.

Imagery, detector checkpoints and per-frame detection caches are not redistributed. GrapeMOTS is published under CC-BY by Ariza-Sentis et al., Data in Brief 54 (2024) 110432.
